name: Jabbertoon tools for AI assistants and developers
description: The same tools as Jabbertoon's MCP server (https://jabbertoon.com/mcp), over plain HTTP. No key and no account. GET answers the read tools whose arguments are plain values; POST a JSON object of arguments to any tool. Nothing sent to validate or share_link is stored or logged; report_problem keeps its report for a person to read. Errors are {code, where, says, fix, url}, with did_you_mean and an RFC 6902 patch when the fix is certain. Making the video is done on your own computer, by the jabbertoon tool (preview, render_video). The block language: https://jabbertoon.com/docs/language/
